name: Vincent Harlowe
source: The debonair face of the Harlowe empire is more than he seems on the surface. Behind the glittering man who has it all lurks a terrifying darkness. He would destroy anything and anyone who gets in his way. Can you earn a higher place in Vincent's heart than his ambition?
translation: The debonair face of the Harlowe empire is more than he seems on the surface. Behind the glittering man who has it all lurks a terrifying darkness. He would destroy anything and anyone who gets in his way. Can you earn a higher place in Vincent's heart than his ambition?
